origin.lens: per-kind mutant cap hides the untested operator

description: Net pay = gross + bonus - deduction, with a witness (payroll2) whose every case has bonus = 0 and deduction = 0. Under the capped catalog both this brick and payroll-plus ADMITTED with 13 mutants and 0 survivors, because the cap had already spent the swap-arithmetic budget before it reached the deduction operator. The uncapped catalog must surface it.
